title: Generated procedural material tape binding 53 needs manual graph wiring
body: The material-capable field splice adds RecipeTapeBuffer at binding 53 after static SDI generation, so BuildRenderGraph.cpp must hand-connect the descriptor. The facade/codegen should expose this dynamic binding and derive the connection.

title: VIXEN UI tests need staged asset-root working directory
body: Running test_ui_kit from the repository root failed because assets/ui/kit/ were not present; the target stages assets but CTest and direct invocations do not make the staged root discoverable. The test harness should provision or set its asset working directory automatically.

title: Targeted test binaries need an explicit rebuild witness
body: The editor target rebuilt successfully while test_uber_shader_splice remained stale; the first queued targeted run used the old binary and produced an invalid neutral-variant result. The affected-test workflow should rebuild or verify timestamps for header-driven test consumers before running filters.
